Learning Journey 1 - Group presentation

Sep 21, 2026

GROUP PRESENTATION - Computers in Space

Introduction

This post is a reflection of my first group presentation in the course craft of computing. By this experience, I learned many important things about teamwork, communication, and presentation skills.I done my first presentation on my own was graet experience for me.

Preparation Process

Before the presentation, our team discussed the topic and divided the work among ourselves. Each member was given a specific part to prepare. We also practiced together to make sure the presentation flowed smoothly.

Our Topic

Our presentation topic was Computers in Space. We discussed how computers are used in satellites, spacecraft, and space missions. Computers help in navigation, communication, data collection, and controlling systems in space.

My Part

I handled the summary part of the presentation. I summarized all the important points covered by my teammates (introduction, evolution, uses, and challenges of computers in space). I also included key takeaways and future expectations related to computers in space. My role was to conclude the presentation in a clear and organized way. I made sure the summary connected all the parts presented by the team.

Teamwork and Collaboration

Working in a group taught me the importance of coordination. We shared ideas, helped each other, and made sure everyone was clear about their responsibilities. This experience improved my ability to work with others.

Topic of members

Visaka explained the introduction and she started the main content of the topic (how computers work in space). Komal covered the evolution of computers in satellites and spacecraft in space. Ravi also spoke about the challenges computers face in space (like Radiation). Srithar explained the reflection part of the topic. I handled the summary part at the end and I include some extra impoartant points needed then give a perfect conclusion .

Group discussion

We discussed and divided the topics among ourselves before starting the work. Each member shared their ideas and suggestions during our group discussions. We helped each other improve the content by giving feedback. Through discussion, we made sure there was no repetition in our parts. We coordinated the flow of the presentation so that it looked connected from start to end.

Challenges

Coordinating with team members was difficult due to different schedules. Managing time during the presentation was also hard as we had five members.

Time

  • Coordinating with team members was sometimes difficult because of different schedules.
  • Team people not coordinate much at the first due to none of us know anyone before the class.
  • Even tough the time given for it was more its feels something was lack we actually no idea at the starting what to do.
  • Although we tried best to cooperate the timing between everyone’s availability actually play a lot.

Duration

  • Managing time during the presentation was a challenge.
  • We have five members and everyone prepare a lot on their own so duration actually matters during explaination.
  • The problem is we actually doesn’t give a good reharsal before actual presentation in class.
  • We tried best complete with in 10 mins but we lost.

personal issue

  • I felt nervous while speaking in front of the class a little bit but it’s also feels really exciting.
  • Explaining some technical points clearly was not easy because the first time.
  • Even tough everyone knows english the actual communication sometimes lag’s due to some speak their mother tongue.
  • Some it feels very repeating work due to everyone prepare thier’s and explain it to others.

Benefits

This presentation improved my teamwork and communication skills. It also helped me gain confidence in speaking and organizing content.

What I Learned

  • Good communication is the key to successful teamwork.
  • Proper preparation and practice reduce nervousness.
  • Time management is very important during presentations.
  • Confidence improves when we practice more.
  • Listening to feedback from teammates helps improve the final presentation.

Skills Improved

  • Public speaking
  • Team coordination
  • Time management
  • Content organization
  • Confidence while presenting

Conclusion

End of the day, this group presentation was a valuable learning experience for me. It help’s me a lot to understand my strengths and the areas I need to improve. I will work on my communication skills and confidence for future presentations and projects.
